title: She Swore I Worked There Because Of My Jacket. Security Had Other Plans.
script: I was shopping for paint in the same green jacket the store's employees happen to wear, and a woman marched up demanding I find her a specific shade of touch-up paint right now. I told her twice that I didn't work there and was just a customer, but she talked over me both times and said she would report me to my manager for being unhelpful. A real employee walked over to help, and she immediately pointed at me and claimed I had been rude to her first, trying to get him in trouble too. He asked the front desk to check the camera near the paint aisle, just to be thorough. The footage showed me calmly saying I didn't work there, twice, while she ignored me and kept talking. Store security walked her out for harassing staff, and the real employee thanked me for staying so calm. I still don't own a single can of that paint.
